description: Put the user's list of business locations up for sale on LocationLists. They keep 80% of each sale; we host, check out, deliver and pay out. No account. THE STEPS, each one call: (1) call with the user's email alone: a six-digit code is emailed to them (ask the user for their email first; never invent one). (2) Ask the user for the code from that email (never guess it) and call again with email, code, and the list: `rows` inline, an array of objects, one per location, with a name and an address or latitude/longitude (up to 5,000 rows), or for a bigger file `filename` + `bytes` and no rows, which returns an upload_url (HTTP PUT the raw file to it) and a token. (3) After the PUT, call with token, upload_id and filename. Add what (one sentence), rows_claimed and target_usd from price_my_list when you have them. Then everything is by email to the seller: the written listing with its checks and price in a few minutes, Confirm / Change links, and 'It's live' after LocationLists reviews it. Accepted: CSV, TSV, JSON, GeoJSON. Nothing goes live without the seller's confirmation and a human review. The same thing in a browser: https://locationlists.com/sell.

bytes.description: The file's size in bytes, with filename, for an upload URL

code.description: The six-digit code from the email we sent, as the user read it to you

email.description: The seller's email, exactly as the user gave it. Every message about the list goes there.

filename.description: The file's name with its extension (.csv, .tsv, .json, .geojson); with bytes and no rows, asks for an upload URL

rows.description: The list itself, one object per location, up to 5,000. Keep the user's own column names.

rows_claimed.description: About how many rows, as the user said

target_usd.description: The price the user wants for the whole file, US dollars (ends in 9 after rounding)

token.description: The token a previous sell_list call returned with an upload_url

upload_id.description: The upload_id from the upload_url call, after the PUT finished

what.description: What the list is, one sentence, in the user's words

name: sell_list
title: Sell a list on LocationLists
